name: Benjamin Byron Davis
bio: Benjamin Byron Davis (born on June 21, 1972 in Boston, Massachusetts, USA), is an American actor, writer, director and acting coach. He is best known for his performance as Dutch van der Linde in the Red Dead Redemption video game series.

credits.title: Ice Cream Man
credits.overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

credits.title: Borderlands
credits.overview: Returning to her home planet, an infamous bounty hunter forms an unexpected alliance with a team of unlikely heroes. Together, they battle monsters and dangerous bandits to protect a young girl who holds the key to unimaginable power.

credits.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
credits.overview: Peter Quill, still reeling from the loss of Gamora, must rally his team around him to defend the universe along with protecting one of their own. A mission that, if not completed successfully, could quite possibly lead to the end of the Guardians as we know them.

credits.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
credits.overview: Just when his time under house arrest is about to end, Scott Lang once again puts his freedom at risk to help Hope van Dyne and Dr. Hank Pym dive into the quantum realm and try to accomplish, against time and any chance of success, a very dangerous rescue mission.

credits.title: Madtown
credits.overview: A scientist has a revelation after his dog dies and leaves his job to start walking dogs.

credits.title: The Belko Experiment
credits.overview: A group of eighty American workers are locked in their office and ordered by an unknown voice to participate in a twisted game.

credits.title: Black Eyed Sue
credits.overview: Schuyler and Osbourne Crawl must resolve a curse that was put on their father for his part in the slaughter of a Native-American village. credits.title: Flushed
credits.overview: A series of comic vignettes that take place primarily in a nightclub women's and men's room.

credits.title: Getting Personal
credits.overview: Young professionals Christopher and Melissa meet and fall hard for each other. As their attraction grows, it becomes apparent that in order for their relationship to succeed, they must overcome Christopher's dark secret involving his father, with the help of his best friend and a sharp-edged psychiatrist.
